Extend that planted lower shin DOWNWARD by about 14 native pixels on the 1254 canvas, and redraw the complete same-size planted boot 14 pixels LOWER. Lowest visible support sole should now reach normalized y=.941, not above .931. Do not add a floor or contact shadow. Do not modify the trailing near RIGHT lifted leg or boot.
Maintain clear near right passing thigh in front of far left supporting thigh. Exactly two legs and two arms. Right hand holds original short pointed golden thunder wand at side ribs; left hand holds rectangular gold plaque forward. No extra fist. Same WHITE crossed shin wraps and black-gold boot size and design, ivory/gold navy-lined costume. Preserve the low weight-bearing pose, not an airborne pose.
True transparent square native RGBA 1280x1280+, no background/shadow/checkerboard/text/effects/grid. One single frame. Target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/max host-managed actual selectors unavailable.
